echoParts: The LORD is on my side
verseText: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
meaning: If God is on our side, we have nothing to fear. How do we know God is on our side? Because he sent his Son to die for us!

recall.question: Who is on the psalmist's side?

meaning.question: Why can believers face people without fear?
choices: God is greater and is for His people

application.prompt: When you worry about what someone might do or think, remember that the Lord is with you.
